faqs.question: How do I book Sam to speak at my event?
faqs.answer: Use the enquiry form on this page — choose 'Speaking Engagements' as the enquiry type and tell us about your event, audience and dates. You'll hear back within 2–3 working days.

faqs.question: What topics does Sam speak about?
faqs.answer: Youth leadership, disaster response and community resilience, mobilising people through social media, entrepreneurship and co-creating change — drawing on the Student Volunteer Army story and his governance career.

faqs.question: Is Sam available for governance or advisory roles?
faqs.answer: Sam is a Chartered Member of the Institute of Directors and holds several board roles. Use the enquiry form with 'Governance Opportunities' selected and include details about your organisation.

faqs.question: How quickly will I hear back?
faqs.answer: Typical response time is 2–3 working days for all enquiries.
